subject: Certificate error when using shinyapps::setAccountInfo() from behind a firewall

messages.author: 851baabb324f1dd1
messages.subject: Certificate error when using shinyapps::setAccountInfo() from behind a firewall
parts:
I get the below error when using the setAccountInfo() function from my computer

 > shinyapps::setAccountInfo(name="myName", token="tokenNum", secret="secretNum")
Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE)  : 
  SSL certificate problem, verify that the CA cert is OK. Details:
error:14090086:SSL routines:SSL3_GET_SERVER_CERTIFICATE:certificate verify failed

When launching it from my personal laptop (not behind a firewall) everything works fine.

Is there a way to sort it out (like importing the certificate from my laptop)?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Certificate error when using shinyapps::setAccountInfo() from behind a firewall
parts:
Hi,

It sounds like you are having some issue with your firewall or proxy settings. You can try to fallback to using insecure calls to shinyapps by running:

options(shinyapps.service_url = "http://api.shinyapps.io/v1")

-Andy

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Certificate error when using shinyapps::setAccountInfo() from behind a firewall
parts:
I suspect your application name is invalid.  Application names must be at least 3 characters and cannot contain spaces. The application name defaults to the name of the directory where the application files are (which defaults to the current working directory).

If this is the case you can either a) rename your application directory 

or b) manually specify an application name

deployApp(appName="some-name")
